notes.title: Update 2.0.3 Release Notes
notes.content:
With Update 2.0.3, we mainly focus on minor improvements and bug fixes. We are also preparing for the sequel.

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added two new password-activated Easter Eggs to the main menu.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Implemented small changes and fixes for the Hidden Adventure.
[*] Updated the main menu layout.
[*] Made small fixes and updates for the main game.
[/list]

Thank you for playing and providing valuable feedback. Have fun!

notes.title: Small Improvements
notes.content:
With Update 1.2.4 come some minor visual improvements, bug fixes, as well as one new Easter Egg for the main menu.

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new password activated Easter Egg to the main menu.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in the Hidden Adventure that was causing unexpected behavior with one of the possible paths. The adventure is now fully functional.
[*] Improved the map of the first half of the Hidden Adventure to be more easily traversable in a specific area.
[*] Enhanced the user interface for a more intuitive and seamless experience. Enjoy a polished and visually appealing interface.
[/list]

Thank you for playing and providing valuable feedback. Have fun!

notes.title: Mighty improvements
notes.content:
With Update 1.2.2 come various performance, interaction and also some minor visual improvements.


[b]Additions:[/b]

Added an additional hint in room 13


[b]Improvements:[/b]

Many performance improvements not only make for better overall frame rates, but also reduce any frame rate drops you might have encountered in the past
Improved player movement to make traversal more enjoyable
Added sounds when hatches of cube containers are opening
Improved the sound timings of opening doors
Reduced game disk space usage from ~825 MB to ~489 MB
Improved And-Node and Or-Node visibility


[b]Changes:[/b]

Upgraded the project to Unity 2021
Switched to the Vulkan graphics API
Changed cube physics to be more in line with how the cubes are intended to feel
Cubes now rotate freely when held
One very special cube is now very bouncy
Slightly altered the physics of cubes to be a bit more natural


[b]Notable:[/b]

The mysterious and hidden "adventure" got even more mysterious and hidden, as no matter what I do, the scene cannot be opened in Unity and therefore can not be changed anymore (it may not be as enjoyable as the rest of the game... but it was never meant to be anyway)


Have fun!

notes.title: More Easter Eggs & Hotfix for Update 1.2
notes.content:
Update 1.2.1 is mainly a hotfix. A bug was fixed where a certain door would unintentionally open, but the player couldn't get through. However, this did not prevent progression in the game.

In addition, three more Easter Eggs have been implemented to match the new menu password input field.

Have fun!

notes.title: Mystery awaits
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522293/e7f17a6b5918a4abef09d36eef50f31b2b346848.jpg[/img]

This is the biggest Update for [b]Examination Chambers[/b] yet. With Update 1.2 you can enjoy the improved visual quality as well as the added hidden content!

[previewyoutube=79G0pT4o6uo;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*] Added a Password Input Field to the Menu
[*] Added several Easter Eggs to the Menu
[*] Added a new game mode/experience that is hard to find and even harder to play through (This is intended; Congratulations to all who discover it or even play through it)
[*] Added a Sprinting Effect to give the player more visual feedback
[*] Improved the Post Processing Effects to increase visual fidelity
[*] Changed the Main Menu to better fit a wider variety of aspect ratios
[*] Implemented Developer Commands
[*] Implemented some more minor Fixes and Improvements
[/list]

With the new Password Input Field you are able to enter certain Keywords to trigger corresponding events. For example you can enter "Credits" to instantly unlock the Credits Button in the Menu without finishing the game first. Another example: Type in "Dark" to disable the lights in the menu background. Have fun!
